svg.title: Each token is one running vector that every part adds to
svg.desc: Four tokens, a fluffy blue creature, each drawn as a vertical line running from embedding at the bottom to scores at the top. Along each line, attention and MLP boxes read from the line and add their result back with a plus sign. Attention boxes also take arrows from earlier tokens' lines; MLP boxes don't.
svg.text: Each token is one running vector that every part adds to

g.text: Dashed arrows: what creature's attention reads from earlier tokens.
Every token's attention does the same; only creature's is drawn.

svg.text: Idea adapted from Elhage et al., “A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits” (Anthropic, 2021).
